title: Puzzle 3d Marquee Preview Perf
description: Add live highlight preview while dragging rectangle/lasso marquee and eliminate post-release freeze by caching projected footprints once per gesture and deferring host shell rebuild.
summary: Fixed ~2s group-selection startup stall. Root cause: first marquee gesture synchronously called Box3.setFromObject for every object, triggering cold geometry.computeBoundingBox on all meshes before the overlay rectangle painted. Changes: (1) warmObjectGroupMarqueeBounds + idle deferred warm-up from registerObject; (2) MarqueeBridge paints overlay first on activation and defers captureMarqueeCandidates/preview to requestAnimationFrame with cancel on gesture abort; (3) scheduleDeferredCallback shared with relocate commit; (4) vitest coverage for warm-up. All 178 @puzzle/3d/react tests pass.
